property_summary: When calling owned(), the owner must not change.
Calling owned() must not revert when caller is the owner.
After calling owned() with any msg.sender, the owner remains unchanged (no owner transfer occurs).
The owner does not change after owned() is called by any address.
After calling owned() with any msg.sender, the owner remains unchanged.
The owner after owned() call is the same as before the call.
After calling owned(), the contract owner is the same as before the call.
After calling owned(), the owner of the contract is the address that was the owner before the call, not the caller of owned() itself.
After a call to owned(), the contract owner remains unchanged (i.e., calling owned() does not change the owner).
After calling owned(), the contract owner is the same as the address originally passed to transferOwnership, not the caller of owned().
